description: TY2026: the classic AMT trigger — a $300,000 ISO bargain element held past year-end. Regular tax on TI 233,900 = 51,304. AMTI = 233,900 + 16,100 standard-deduction addback + 300,000 ISO = 550,000; the OBBBA-reset phase-out bites: exemption 90,100 - 50% x 50,000 = 65,100 -> base 484,900 -> TMT 26% x 244,500 + 28% x 240,400 = 130,882 -> AMT $79,578.00. Net = 51,304 + 79,578 + 450 Additional Medicare = $131,332.00.
